falseFriends.performance: In TAK/OEE context, use 'anläggningsutnyttjande' (the 'A' component), not generic 'prestanda'
falseFriends.station: Use 'arbetsstation' for manufacturing workstation; 'station' means train/bus station
falseFriends.scrap: Use 'kassation' for quality-rejected units, not 'skrot' (metal recycling waste)
falseFriends.shift: 'Skift' is correct for work shift; also means keyboard Shift key — unambiguous in manufacturing
falseFriends.effective: 'Effektiv' can mean 'efficient' (not same as 'effective'). Use 'ändamålsenlig' for goal-achieving.

grammarNotes.compoundWords: Swedish forms compounds: 'cykeltid' (cycle time), 'driftstopp' (downtime). Never split: 'cykeltid' not 'cykel tid'.
grammarNotes.enEtt: Two genders with 'en' (common, ~75%) and 'ett' (neuter, ~25%). Definite form is suffix: 'maskinen', 'skiftet'.
grammarNotes.definiteNounSuffix: Swedish appends definite article as suffix: 'Tillgängligheten är 85%' vs 'Beräkna tillgänglighet'.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: Swedish compound words inherently use singular modifier stems. Compound formation handles modifier singularity by construction. No compound pluralization issue.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: Sweden has TAK (Tillgänglighet x Anläggningsutbyte x Kvalitet) as established OEE equivalent. Both TAK and OEE used interchangeably.
industryContext.takAcronym: TAK = Tillgänglighet (availability), Anläggningsutbyte (performance), Kvalitet (quality). Documented by Novotek, MaintMaster.
industryContext.dominantSectors: Automotive (Volvo, Scania), mining (Sandvik, Atlas Copco), defense (Saab), pulp/paper, engineering

commonMistakes: Using 'ni' instead of 'du' — 'du' is correct since du-reformen 1967
Splitting compound words: 'cykel tid' instead of 'cykeltid'
Using 'skrot' for production scrap instead of 'kassation'
Ignoring TAK — the culturally resonant Swedish OEE equivalent should be documented
Wrong article (en vs ett) for technical nouns
notes: Swedish has TAK as established OEE equivalent. Du-reformen (1967) eliminated formal address; 'du' is universal. P95 expansion 1.64x.
